lines.zh: 魇梦之翼划破夜空，发出低沉啸声。
lines.en: Low moan as nightmare wings slice through the night.

lines.zh: 阴冷气息扑面而来，寒风呼啸。
lines.en: Chilling presence, icy wind whistling by.

lines.zh: 漆黑身躯紧贴列车，夜色中隐现。
lines.en: Black form clings to the train in the night.

lines.zh: 列车行进，它亦随之飘动。
lines.en: Train moves, it follows, swaying along.

lines.zh: 阴风吹动长发，如同鬼魅般飘扬。
lines.en: Grim wind ruffling its hair, like a ghostly apparition.

lines.zh: 眼睛闪烁红光，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Red eyes glow, fixated on the player.

lines.zh: 低鸣声中，列车疾驰而过。
lines.en: Low moan as the train speeds by.
Tusks peeking out in the darkness.
Voice from the shadows.
Chases the target, steps firm.
The rails groan beneath me.
The train and I grind forward together.
Silent, it stares into the distance.

lines.zh: 长发随风轻拂，如幽灵般游荡。
lines.en: Hair swaying in the wind, like a ghostly wanderer.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的孤影，静静守护。
lines.en: Solitary figure in the dark, silently guarding.

lines.zh: 月光下它的身影若隐若现。
lines.en: Faint silhouette under moonlight.

lines.zh: 安静时，它的呼吸几乎听不见。
lines.en: Almost inaudible breathing in silence.

lines.zh: 在无限列车旁静静等待。
lines.en: Quietly waits beside the endless train.
Silently hides in the night.

lines.zh: 一动不动，似乎融入黑暗。
lines.en: Motionless, blending into the darkness.
It follows like a shadow in the dark.
Observing quietly, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着玩家，发出低沉的呜咽声。
lines.en: Its eyes on the player, a low moan.
Noting the player, it slowly approaches.

lines.zh: 目光紧锁玩家，它准备攻击。
lines.en: Steady gaze on the player, ready to attack.
Holding the player’s gaze, it won’t let go.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛似乎在暗中窥视玩家。
lines.en: Its eyes peer at the player in the dark.
Eyes like cold stars, piercing the player.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，它显得异常警惕。
lines.en: Its eyes are wary, fixed on the player.
Its vigilance heightened by the player’s presence.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着对玩家的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with desire for the player.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，它的眼神中充满怨恨。
lines.en: Its gaze full of resentment, fixed on the player.
A mournful cry
Weak struggling
Pained roar
The train body shudders and hisses.
Soft moan
This whole carriage is my dream.
Struggling frantically

lines.zh: 铁皮车厢从我背上裂开一道。
lines.en: The steel car splits open along my back.

lines.zh: 整列车的灯，跟着我一起闪。
lines.en: Every lamp in the train flickers with me.
The train and my dream ache together.

lines.zh: 漆黑身影悄无声息逼近，你感受到深渊的呼唤吗？
lines.en: Dark silhouette approaches silently, do you feel the abyss calling?

lines.zh: 那对血红的眼睛似乎在你心中留下烙印。
lines.en: Those blood-red eyes seem to leave a mark on your soul.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意沿着脊梁骨而上。
lines.en: A chill runs down your spine.

lines.zh: 它低吟着无惨之血的诱惑。
lines.en: It moans the temptation of Urasawa's blood.

lines.zh: 魇梦的触手伸向你，你能否抵抗？
lines.en: Urasawa's tentacles reach for you, can you resist?

lines.zh: 阳光无法触及这无尽的黑暗。
lines.en: Sunlight cannot reach this endless darkness.

lines.zh: 它的存在是对抗阳光的试炼。
lines.en: Its existence is a trial against sunlight.

lines.zh: 它渴望吞噬你，成为下一个猎物。
lines.en: It craves to devour you and make you its next meal.

lines.zh: 魇梦的血，无惨之血，诱惑着你。
lines.en: Urasawa's blood, a temptation for you.

lines.zh: 它用无惨之血强化自身力量。
lines.en: It strengthens itself with Urasawa's blood.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，你撞上了魇梦的身躯。
lines.en: A thud, you collide with Enmu's body.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵剧痛，魇梦撞了过来。
lines.en: You feel a sharp pain as Enmu collides with you.

lines.zh: 魇梦挥舞着铁轨，试图击退你。
lines.en: Enmu swings the tracks, trying to repel you.

lines.zh: 铁轨与你擦身而过，留下一道印记。
lines.en: Tracks scrape past you, leaving a mark.

lines.zh: 它躲开了你的攻击，却将你撞飞。
lines.en: It dodges your attack and sends you flying.

lines.zh: 魇梦的攻击让你感到头晕目眩。
lines.en: Enmu's attack leaves you dizzy.

lines.zh: 铁轨如同巨锤，撞击你的身体。
lines.en: Tracks slam into your body like a hammer.

lines.zh: 你与魇梦的铁轨发生碰撞，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: You collide with Enmu's tracks, the pain unbearable.

lines.zh: 魇梦用铁轨制造混乱，你难以站稳。
lines.en: Enmu uses the tracks to create chaos, making it hard for you to stand.

lines.zh: 你的攻击被铁轨反弹回来。
lines.en: Your attack bounces back at you with the tracks.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的呢喃声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It emits a low rumbling sound, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 魇梦用触手缠绕你，寻求交配。
lines.en: Enmu uses its tentacles to缠绕 you, seeking mating.

lines.zh: 我的触手想缠住你的手腕。
lines.en: My tentacles want to coil around your wrists.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕你，试图将你拉近。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, trying to pull you closer.

lines.zh: 魇梦的身躯紧贴你的，仿佛要拥抱你。
lines.en: Enmu's body presses against you, as if to hug you.

lines.zh: 它用触手探索你的身体，寻找交配的机会。
lines.en: It uses its tentacles to explore your body, seeking mating opportunities.

lines.zh: 它的低吟声在你耳边回响，寻求共鸣。
lines.en: Its moans echo in your ears, seeking共鸣.

lines.zh: 魇梦试图用它的力量吸引你。
lines.en: Enmu attempts to attract you with its strength.

lines.zh: 它试图通过力量迫使你与之交配。
lines.en: It tries to force you to mate with it through strength.

lines.zh: 它的触手在你身上游走，寻找交配的机会。
lines.en: Its tentacles roam your body, seeking mating opportunities.

lines.zh: 我感到一股血液的气息！
lines.en: Blood scent!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队成员的味道，真不错。
lines.en: Taste of Demon Slayer, delightful.
Devour their souls.
Blood Skill should be here.
Will sunlight harm me?
I won't die easily.
All are my prey.
Night is my strength.
Perfect habitat for me.
No one escapes me.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队成员，找上门来了。
lines.en: Demon Slayers, here they come.

lines.zh: 列车还在跑，猎物已经上车。
lines.en: The train still runs, and my prey is aboard.
Hunting begins.
They'll be my meal.
Watch out for my claws.
Feel the power of Enmu.
They can't escape.
Target locked.
Patience to the limit.
Fight begins!
A Demon Slayer is aboard.
The wheels roll and I arrive.
This whole train is my body.
Sleep. You are easier prey in dreams.
You boarded. You will not get off.
You won't escape.
Kill in sunlight.

lines.zh: 列车加速，我的触手先到。
lines.en: The train speeds up, but my tentacles arrive first.

lines.zh: 这节车厢归我，梦里也归我。
lines.en: This carriage is mine, in dreams as well.
My attack is flawless.
I will consume all.
The train moves, and so do I.
My shadow follows you.

lines.zh: 我的影子爬满这节车厢的墙。
lines.en: My shadow crawls across the walls of this car.

lines.zh: 没有人能逃离我的掌控。
lines.en: None escape my control.
Car by car, the doors seal shut.
Your dreams belong to me.
The rails bend, and so do you.
Do not sleep. You may not wake.
Moonlight never reaches this car.

lines.zh: 车厢摇晃，我跟着你的鼾声。
lines.en: The car sways, and I follow your snoring.
The whole car is my hand.
Run. The engine is still far.
Do you hear the snoring?
No one comes for you in a dream.
Ghost approaching!
Your flesh...

lines.zh: 列车和我，已经长在一起。
lines.en: The train and I have grown together.
Sunlight is useless!
The end of the train!

lines.zh: 车门锁死，铁皮朝你挤过来。
lines.en: The doors lock, and the steel closes in on you.
My strength is greater!
Sun Corps, perish!

lines.zh: 终点站的灯灭了，你到站了。
lines.en: The terminal lights go out — this is your stop.
Rails tear up from under your feet!
The car walls press in!
Sleep now. Stop struggling.
You stopped breathing in the dream.
The wheels crush your shadow!
This claw is for the Demon Slayers!
Under the moon, only I am awake!
My dream has no need of your waking!
Last stop. Please get off!
Train begins to shake...
Noymoon awakens...
End of the train appears!
New enemies arrive!
Noymoon born in the train!
Appears at the train's end!
Noymoon and train merge!
Noymoon at train's end!
Noymoon merges with train!
Noymoon born at train's end!

lines.zh: 魇梦与无限列车融为一体。
lines.en: Enmu fuses with the Infinity Train.
The headlamp lights and I open my eyes.
Fangs begin to grow from the cars.
This train has a master now.
Severe burning
Pain from falling

lines.zh: 水漫进车厢，我的梦也湿了。
lines.en: Water floods the car, and even my dream is soaked.
Pain from explosion

lines.zh: 车顶被打穿，夜露渗进来。
lines.en: The roof is pierced; night air seeps in.
Torn by magic
Starve me further and the train stops.
Severe lightning pain

lines.zh: 列车与我的梦，一起沉下去。
lines.en: The train and my dream sink together.
